sections.title: Minor Requirements
sections.note: Earning a minor in Design and Environmental Analysis (DEA) requires a minimum of 15 credits in DEA courses. To be considered for the Minor in DEA, students must not be a DEA major. Students must complete the following core requirements in any order: DEA 1500 Introduction to Environmental Psychology. In addition, students must complete: One DEA studio course Two upper-level DEA thematic courses For detailed course requirements and a list of eligible electives, please refer to the Application to Graduate with a Minor in Design and Environmental Analysis (contact program coordinator for form). After completing courses (DEA 1110 Making a Difference by Design or DEA 2200 Art and Science, and DEA 1501 Introduction to Environmental Psychology - Writing in the Major) students should submit the Intention to Minor in DEA form (contact program coordinator for form).
